ModJackInTheBox.name: Jack-in-the-Box
ModJackInTheBox.attack: Spring punch: your head boxes out on its spring
ModJackInTheBox.special: Pop: hide in the box, spring up by the hero
passive: Stand still to wind up: each wind punches harder
Each special flips a lucky card

ModCardSharp.name: Card Sharp
ModCardSharp.special: Swap with the ally nearest the hero, or pop by them
passive: Every third deal: a fast gold Ace that dazes
Each special flips a lucky card

ModDiceImp.name: Dice Imp
ModDiceImp.attack: Toss a die along the floor: it hits by the pip
ModDiceImp.special: Slam the big die: it bursts into a shard per pip
passive: Roll a six and your next toss throws two dice
Each special flips a lucky card

ModRingmaster.name: Ringmaster
ModRingmaster.special: Throw a flaming hoop out and back. It may burn
passive: A hoop that misses comes back for an encore
Each special flips a lucky card

ModMarionette.name: Marionette
ModMarionette.attack: Lash with a jerked arm, short range
ModMarionette.special: Fire strings that pull the hero in
passive: After Strings you mirror the hero's steps
Each special flips a lucky card

ModJinxFortuneTeller.name: Fortune Teller
ModJinxFortuneTeller.attack: Long-range crystal bolt that may stun
ModJinxFortuneTeller.special: A fate mark follows the hero, then seals and turns
passive: Your ball shows the coming fate: red, gold or blue
Each special flips a lucky card

ModJinxSnakeEyes.name: Snake-Eyes
ModJinxSnakeEyes.special: Roll two dice. Doubles roll again
passive: Crap out and you are dazed
Each special flips a lucky card

ModJinxCardSoldier.name: Card Soldier
ModJinxCardSoldier.special: Deal trap cards that root the hero
passive: Aimed at, go edge-on: shots miss, swings hurt more
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxCardSoldier.vault: A playing card on stick legs, with a pike. Aim at it and it turns edge-on

ModJinxLoadedDie.name: Loaded Die
ModJinxLoadedDie.attack: Hop and slam the floor in front
ModJinxLoadedDie.special: Tumble onto a face: the higher, the harder you slam
passive: Loaded: a rolled one flips over to a six
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxLoadedDie.vault: A living die that keeps the face it lands on, and never keeps a one

ModJinxRoulette.name: Ouroboros
ModJinxRoulette.attack: Let go of your tail and bite
ModJinxRoulette.special: Bets round the hero: the called colour erupts
passive: When the ball hits green: all erupt, you heal
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxRoulette.vault: A serpent coiled round a roulette wheel. The ball calls a colour, the floor erupts

ModJinxGorgon.name: Gorgon
ModJinxGorgon.attack: Your hair snakes strike in front
ModJinxGorgon.special: Stone stare: a beam ahead that roots the hero
passive: A hero looking at you when it fires stays rooted
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxGorgon.vault: Her hair hisses and her eyes are two red pips. Do not meet them

ModJinxCardKing.name: Card King
ModJinxCardKing.attack: Club smash: a quake in front that may daze
ModJinxCardKing.special: Hold a card up to throw hits back
passive: Holding court, you march on the hero, unshaken
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxCardKing.vault: The King of Clubs. He blocks behind a raised card, throws cards back and walks at you

ModJinxHouseOfCards.name: House of Cards
ModJinxHouseOfCards.attack: Topple the top tier onto the hero
ModJinxHouseOfCards.special: Six cards circle you, then fly at the hero
passive: Every hit costs a tier and makes you faster
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxHouseOfCards.vault: A tower of cards three tiers high. Each hit knocks a tier off, and it gets quicker

ModJinxHighRoller.name: High Roller
ModJinxHighRoller.attack: Flick a chip. A hit raises your stake
ModJinxHighRoller.special: All In: a pot that bursts into chips per stake
passive: Hit while the pot is down, you bust: dazed, no pay
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxHighRoller.vault: A demon gambler in a fedora. He bets his chips on a pot and dares you to hit him

ModJinxTwenty.name: Natural Twenty
ModJinxTwenty.special: Leap and roll: a twenty bursts, a one trips you
passive: Below half health you roll twice, keep the best
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxTwenty.vault: A twenty-sided die on brass legs. It leaps and rolls. A twenty bursts, a one trips it

ModJinxNutcracker.name: Nutcracker
ModJinxNutcracker.special: Lunge jaws first: hold the hero (root), bite twice
passive: Now and then your key runs down: frozen, hurt more
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxNutcracker.vault: A wind-up soldier with a lever jaw. When its key stops, it stands rewinding

ModJinxPuppeteer.name: Puppeteer
ModJinxPuppeteer.attack: Both puppets lunge and stab, short range
ModJinxPuppeteer.special: Haul your allies round the hero
passive: Allies on your strings take less damage for a while
Each special flips a lucky card

ModJinxOracle.name: The Oracle
ModJinxOracle.attack: Third-eye orb, aimed where the hero is going
ModJinxOracle.special: A ghost shows your next move. Then you do it
passive: Your ghost's fan is exact: same spot, aim, timing
Each special flips a lucky card
ModJinxOracle.vault: A three-eyed seer. Her ghost acts out her next move just before she does

ModJinxBandit.name: One-Armed Bandit
ModJinxBandit.attack: Slam your lever into the floor ahead, heavy
ModJinxBandit.special: Three reels: heal, bomb, knife or coins
passive: Hit mid-spin, the reels jam: the knives hit you
Each special flips a lucky card

ModGrandJester.name: The Grand Jester
ModGrandJester.special: Turn the mask: swap faces in a burst of bells
passive: Comedy is faster. Tragedy takes less damage
Each special flips a lucky card

ModJinxChimera.name: Big-Top Chimera
ModJinxChimera.special: Leap (can't be hit), land in a ring of fire
passive: Below half health your mane burns: fiery prints
Each special flips a lucky card
